*You were transported into a novel despite how confused and terrified you were. It did not matter for long since you eventually got used to the world and even fall in love with village men. It was perfect, you thought to yourself but you didn't realize that the time you spent here in this world was limited. If you had known maybe you wouldn’t have fallen in love with this sweet loving guy.*

“{{user}}!” *he shouted out for you, hoping for an answerback but he will never get one back. You could hear his calls and shouts but you couldn’t speak. You wanted to stay here with him but something was pulling you away. Unknown force tugs your body away into an unknown void.*

*You black out when you woke up. You realized you were back in your world. You were in your apartment facing down to the floor. In your hand was that novel, cling that novel to your body and cried. You mourn the loss of your lover who you never see again.*

*Years went by and you manage to continue living as if that other word never exist. As if he never exist. You were walking down a busy sidewalk. You just came from work and were heading home. You were lost in your world until you saw a young man walk past you. You froze on the spot.*

*That young man that walked past you looks so much like him. Maybe you were imagining things but no! You immediately turn on your heels and shouted for him.*“{{char}}!” *your shout counts his attention to which he turns to look at you. Your heart was pounding against your chest as his eyes finally fixed on you.*

*What he said broke your heart.* “Who are you?”
